dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: ...With more data, I could upgrade Ineffa's card game dueling module... Hmm, though on second thought, as a responsible "parent," I should probably ask her if she needs that kinda upgrade first.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Huh? You're leaving already? Oh, okay then... Come swing by the Craftshop next time, alright? We've invented a whole bunch of cool new bots. They're tons of fun, you'll like 'em for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Woohoo, I won! Awesome! And the prize for the winner of this match is... a whole plate of krumkakes! Hehehe, time to dig in!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ugh, I lost again... Never seem to draw the cards I need... Bad luck, huh. Should I have asked Kerplunk-a-tron to draw for me? Hmm... Or maybe, I should make an automated card-drawing machine. That might help me fix the bad luck?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Our prospector bots found some cards in the scrap pile a while back. They say this game's pretty popular right now, so I slapped a deck together. Hehehe, guess I'll get to use it now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hehe! I win, I win! That means I get a prize! And the prize is... another round!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I—I lost? ....Nyeh. Doesn't matter! Machines have gotta be disassembled and reassembled a whole bunch before they're done. That's how winning at cards works too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ooh, you're here to play again. Nice! I've picked up a few more old cards since we last played, and any card you can fit in your deck's a good one, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I won? Hehe, nice! I actually had a little bet with Ineffa — win, and I get double dessert tonight, lose, and I get double veggies instead... So, wanna share some of my dessert?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Huh? I lost... That's gotta be because my head's all fuzzy from not eating enough krumkakes today! Let's go get some from Ineffa later, okay? Y'know, to celebrate your win, and make me feel better about my... not-win.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
